mechanism: Prednisone may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of guanfacine through mineralocorticoid effects and sodium/fluid retention, while guanfacine may potentiate corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and blood glucose levels; may require guanfacine dose adjustment or alternative antihypertensive; assess for fluid retention and electrolyte imbalances during concurrent use.
